title: Americans Want Democratic Change but Feel Stuck
discussion_signal: The Pew researcher frames public dissatisfaction as coexisting with a desire to keep imagining and building democratic change, linking survey findings about support for major reform to a question of whether people feel capable of collective action.
linked_research_question: How can democratic dissatisfaction become constructive reform energy when confidence in institutions and the feasibility of change are both weak?
limits: The post is interpretive and motivational as well as evidentiary
It does not show that expressed reform demand produces action
